rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is the primary identifier and one-to-one join key with Acc_Info_dirty. No missing values currently observed, but mandatory for referential integrity.

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a unique table-level identifier and one-to-one join key. All 30 values are currently distinct.

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is designated as a one-to-one key with Acc_Info_dirty.S_N. Referential integrity must be enforced to ensure every customer biography record has a corresponding account record.

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier for customer accounts. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit numeric codes ranging from 1001-1028. Must be stored as string to prevent truncation, but format must be 4 digits.

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit code
rationale: Dominant observed format is 4 digits (derived from the data distribution). Values of different lengths are likely truncated, padded, or sentinel values.

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Name is a mandatory demographic field for customer identification. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: Name must follow Title Case convention (excluding lowercase particles bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Evidence shows dominant Title Case convention with deviations: 'lim wei jie' (all lowercase) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all uppercase). Malay/Indian patronymic particles (Bin, Binte, s/o, d/o) should remain lowercase as per cultural convention.

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() if w else False) or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Name particles indicating male gender (Bin, s/o) must correspond to Gender = 'Male'
rationale: Malay 'Bin' and Indian 's/o' (son of) particles encode male gender. Flag records where Gender contradicts these particles.

check_params.logic: (re.search(r'\bBin\b', str(row['Name'])) or re.search(r'\bs/o\b', str(row['Name']))) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male'

rule: Name particles indicating female gender (Binte, d/o) must correspond to Gender = 'Female'
rationale: Malay 'Binte' and Indian 'd/o' (daughter of) particles encode female gender. Flag records where Gender contradicts these particles.

check_params.logic: (re.search(r'\bBinte\b', str(row['Name'])) or re.search(r'\bd/o\b', str(row['Name']))) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female'

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID is mandatory for identity verification. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: S/T/F/G prefix + 7 digits + checksum letter
rationale: 93.3% of values follow standard 9-character format (e.g., S8403757E). Flag non-standard formats like '1916569C' (missing prefix) and 'F212233V' (6 digits).

rule: ID_No must be unique across all records
rationale: National ID numbers should uniquely identify individuals. Evidence shows one duplicate value 'F1011121T' appearing in 2 records.

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Race is a mandatory demographic field. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Evidence shows three semantic categories with case variations (MALAY, malay, indian). Standardise to Title Case and validate against canonical values.

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Gender is a mandatory demographic field. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female
rationale: Evidence shows two categories with case inconsistencies (male, FEMALE). Standardise to Title Case and validate against canonical values.

rule: Age must not be null
rationale: Age is a mandatory demographic field. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: Age must be parseable as an integer
rationale: Column contains non-numeric text value 'Twenty-five' (3.3% of records) which cannot be parsed as integer.

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120
rationale: Domain constraint for human age. Evidence shows values -5 and 4 which are outside realistic human lifespan.

rule: Age must be at least 13 for consumer service accounts
rationale: Dataset appears to be for consumer service delivery. Values below 13 (observed: 4, -5) are unrealistic for independent service accounts and may indicate data entry errors or child accounts requiring verification.

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Contact number is mandatory for customer communication. Evidence shows 2 NULL values (6.7% missing).

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (+65 prefix, 8 digits)
rationale: Evidence shows Singapore country code (65) with inconsistent formatting. Valid Singapore numbers are 8 digits (mobile starting 8/9, landline starting 6). Observed invalid 7-digit number '8964359'.

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is mandatory for customer communication. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Evidence shows 4 structurally malformed values (13.3%): 'not-an-email' (missing @), 'useremail.com' (missing @), 'zx91 @example.com' (contains space), 'nabilah@@example.com' (double @).

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Country is mandatory for address validation. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: Country must be a valid representation of Singapore
rationale: All observed values represent Singapore but in inconsistent forms (Singapore, SINGAPORE, singapore, SG, S'pore, Singapura, Republic of Singapore, 新加坡). Validate against observed set pending standardisation to canonical 'Singapore'.

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is mandatory for address completeness. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: Street_Name must follow Title Case convention
rationale: Evidence shows dominant Title Case with one deviation: 'HOLLAND ROAD' (all caps). Standardise to 'Holland Road'.

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() if w else False) or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Street_Name']).split() if len(w) > 1)

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is mandatory for address validation. No missing values observed (0%).

rule: Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits when represented as string
rationale: Singapore postal codes are 6 digits. Evidence shows variable lengths (4, 5, 6 digits) due to int64 storage truncating leading zeros (e.g., 6907 should be 006907, 99999 should be 099999). Must convert to string and pad to 6 digits.

rule: Account_No must match the corresponding Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: Account_No appears in both tables and should be consistent for the same customer (identified by S_N). Cross-table validation ensures no discrepancies between biography and account records.

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No values must be identical between Cust_Bio_dirty and Acc_Info_dirty for matching S_N

rule: Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for case differences)
rationale: Name in Cust_Bio_dirty and Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty represent the same customer attribute. Cross-table consistency check required despite potential minor formatting differences (e.g., 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin' vs 'Danish').

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name exactly for matching S_N

rule: ID_No must match ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: National ID should be consistent across both tables for the same customer. Evidence shows discrepancy for S_N 16 (S8421753J vs S8421753X).

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must be identical to ID for matching S_N
